title: Exactly two fair contacts are critical on the square lattice, and one is bipartite percolation
subject: Which placed three-variable contacts hold scale-free global emergence on square-lattice tori
conclusion: Among 204 placements of three-variable knots as fair contacts on square-lattice tori, six classes have a vacuum and hold nothing, parity and swap-or-order frustrate locally, and only not-all-equal and 'x or (h ≠ h′)' hold purely global emergence. The latter is consistent exactly when its disequality edges, bond percolation at 1/2, are bipartite, so its emergence is bounded on both sides and is a torus winding quantity that Pinson's conformal formula predicts.
